english_source_note: Uniform Distribution mod 1 and Weyl's Criterion
statement_en: If $f$ is a Riemann integrable function on the closed interval $[a,b]$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exist step functions $g_{\varepsilon},h_{\varepsilon}$ on $[a,b]$ such that for all $x\in [a,b]$, $$g_{\varepsilon}(x)\leq f(x)\leq h_{\varepsilon}(x),$$ and $$\int_a^b\bigl(h_{\varepsilon}(x)-g_{\varepsilon}(x)\bigr)\,dx<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: $f$闭区间$[a,b]$上的Riemann可积函数，对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在$[a,b]$上定义的step function $g_{\varepsilon},h_{\varepsilon}$，使得对所有$x\in [0,1]$都有$$g_{\varepsilon}(x)\leq f(x)\leq h_{\varepsilon}(x)$$并且$$\int_{a}^b (h_{\varepsilon}(x)-g_{\varepsilon}(x))<\varepsilon$$
